name: Wildschönau Brauerei
kurzbeschreibung: **Wildschönau Brewery in Tirol** Discover authentic **Tirol** craft beer at the **Wildschönau Brauerei**, nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal** Alps. Since 1865, this family-run brewery has been brewing traditional **Tiroler** lagers and ales with mountain spring water and locally grown ingredients. After a tour of the historic brewery, enjoy a tasting of their finest beers—from crisp **Helles** to rich **Dunkel**—paired with hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Schlutzkrapfen**. The cozy **Biergarten** offers panoramic views of the **Karwendel** mountains, perfect for unwinding after a day of hiking or skiing. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, the **Wildschönau Brauerei** is an ideal stop for beer lovers and culture seekers alike. Don’t miss their seasonal events, including **Oktoberfest**-style celebrations and live music under the stars. **Visit Wildschönau Brauerei** for a taste of **Tirol’s** finest brews. **Prost!**
